verdict.rationale: Restate's source is public on GitHub (restatedev/restate), and the hosting docs label the self-hosted option "OSS." A community commenter, however, states concretely that the license is BSL and that calling it open source is misleading, because BSL restricts building on it without a commercial subscription. So the source is readable, but whether the license counts as open is contested. Missing for 10: a first-party statement of the actual license terms, and confirmation of an OSI-approved open license.
